about: Numbers the maintainer checked by hand against public complaint sites, usually after a spam report filed as a GitHub issue. merge_community_reports.py publishes each one with a maintainer_review evidence record. Every entry needs the number, a type, the review date and a link to the report. One entry per number. To take an approval back, keep its entry and add "revoked": true and a revoked_at date.
